verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's developer portal offers test accounts for trying custom integrations and apps "without the risk of impacting your production account." These accounts can be populated with sample data and exercised with a pre-built Postman collection, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: detailed docs on how test accounts are provisioned and isolated (limits, parity with production, API key/MCP use against them), any explicit sandbox mode for the MCP server or agent workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
